Business kaise badhaye in hindi

Customer bole mehenga hai, to daam mat ghataiye. Saste wale ka asli kharcha likh ke dikhaiye.

1. Poochiye, ise kitne samay tak use karna hai.
2. Utne samay mein sasta wala kitni baar badalna padega, mehenga wala kitni baar.
3. Kaagaz pe likhiye: 600 x 4 = 2400, aur 1200 x 1 = 1200.
4. Wahi boliye jo sach hai. Pata nahi to andaza mat lagaiye.

Save kar lijiye. Aapke grahak kis cheez pe sabse zyada bolte hain mehenga hai? 👇
